Deterministic seed/subtype/operand traversal records each named identified StructType once, then visits all subtypes transitively. Packedness/opaque/element shapes are included; recursively referenced named definitions appear separately, so named subtypes cannot hide behind names. Literal arrays/vectors/structs/function/target-extension inline forms retain their original complete textual representation plus reachable named definitions.
type_closure.rejection: Unnamed identified types would print transient addresses, so they reject optional projection. Body BlockAddress constants reject. All failures return an empty function projection and both FPM and MIR capture now explicitly refuse empty input/world; the original optimization path remains.

Header TypeFinder includes those header value types. Subject eligibility was not widened to arbitrary external memory/user-call effects; this does not certify arbitrary interprocedural observations of unrelated resolver bodies.
